cues.text: Terahertz communications may offer substantial bandwidth but face demanding propagation and hardware challenges.
Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces seek to influence radio propagation.
Other directions include AI-native network optimisation, integrated sensing and communication, non-terrestrial networks and exploratory quantum communication techniques.
Holographic or immersive communication, Industry five point zero human-machine collaboration, and satellite-terrestrial integration are prospective applications, not guaranteed commercial services.
Spectrum allocation, energy consumption, device affordability, security, integration and unequal access remain challenges.
Compare the different abstractions one more time.
NFV moves specialised network functions into software.
Infrastructure as a service rents infrastructure; networking as a service delivers networking capability.
These solve different problems and can be combined.
Edge placement suits latency-sensitive tasks, while central cloud supports broader historical analysis.
In a smart hospital, evaluate clinical reliability, data protection, power and backhaul, and recovery.
Five G or six G alone does not make a service safe.
